Hidden Bar - An ultra-light MacOS utility that helps hide menu bar icons

summary.one_liner: Hidden Bar is an ultra-light macOS menu bar utility that hides menu bar icons to give the menu bar a cleaner look.
summary.what_it_does: Hidden Bar lets you hide menu bar items on macOS. You arrange its icon in the menu bar with Cmd+drag so that items to its left get collapsed when you click its arrow icon. Clicking the arrow toggles visibility of the hidden items. The README says it is notarized for distribution outside the App Store and can be installed with Homebrew (brew install --cask hiddenbar) or by manual download. Version 1.10 is the last release supporting macOS 10.13 through 12; later versions need macOS 13 because autostart uses the SMAppService API. The README also mentions Terminal-only options and separate documentation for settings, architecture, and maintainer release steps, but those details are not included in the README itself.
use_cases: hide menu bar icons on a Mac
collapse status bar icons with one click
install a menu bar hider with Homebrew
keep menu bar tidy on older Macs (v1.10 for macOS 12 and earlier)
how_to_run: Manual: download the latest version from the releases page
Open the app and drag it to the Applications folder
Launch Hidden and hold CMD to drag its icon to the right of other menu bar icons
Click the Arrow icon to hide or show menu bar items
notable: Ultra-light utility focused on one job: hiding menu bar items
Notarized by Apple for distribution outside the App Store
Legacy v1.10 still available for macOS 10.13 through 12
caveats: Requires macOS 13 (Ventura) or later for current versions; older macOS needs v1.10
Not listed as available on the App Store in the README (the App Store section is empty)
Some settings are described as Terminal-only, per the README
keywords: open source mac menu bar app
